scenes.title: NOT
scenes.narration: NOT reverses a condition, keeping the rows that would otherwise be excluded.

scenes.title: How NOT works
bullets: Flips true to false and back
Pairs with IN, LIKE, and BETWEEN
scenes.narration: NOT inverts the truth of the condition placed after it, so matches become non-matches. A row that would have passed now fails, and vice versa. It commonly teams up with IN, LIKE, and BETWEEN to express exclusions.

scenes.title: Excluding values
scenes.narration: Here NOT IN reverses a membership test against a small list. Any order whose status is cancelled or refunded is excluded. The result keeps every other order, giving a view of the active ones.

scenes.title: Negation in action
scenes.narration: The database first evaluates the condition inside the NOT. It then flips that outcome, turning matches into non-matches. Rows that end up true after the flip are the ones kept.

scenes.text: NOT is the clean way to express exclusions, especially alongside IN, LIKE, and BETWEEN.
scenes.narration: Use NOT to express what you want to exclude, pairing it with operators like IN or LIKE for readable negations.
